pristine.sourcePolicy: byte-exact vendored packages/xstate-react/test/types.test.tsx compiled with the vendored src against react@19.2.3 and @types/react@19.2.17, reproducing upstream's allowImportingTsExtensions

adapted.sourcePolicy: the same suite compiled against @octanejs/xstate through jsxImportSource: octane; the file is prettier-ignored so the one-line difference from upstream stays verifiable by diff

permittedTransformations.rule: the Testing Library entry point retargets Octane's renderer

headerPolicy: The adapted file may prepend a leading run of comments and the JSX pragma. Everything below it must equal the vendored upstream file once the transformations above are undone.

notApplicable.rule: The adapted suite stays .tsx rather than .tsrx. Lowering a .tsrx strips comments before TypeScript sees the program, so its three @ts-expect-error markers would never apply and the negative assertions would silently invert.
